name: Alert
description: Inline feedback message component with CVA variants. Uses grid layout with optional icon. Used for error messages, warnings, sync failures, and informational notices.

variantDimensions.name: variant
variantDimensions.description: Default uses card background; destructive highlights text in destructive red while keeping card background.

representativeVariants.title: Authorization Expired
representativeVariants.description: Please rebind your device to continue.

representativeVariants.title: Update Available
representativeVariants.description: A new version of this course pack is ready.

anatomy.description: Root with role='alert', grid layout, rounded-lg, border, px-2.5, py-2
Optional action area, absolute end-2 top-2

structurePatterns: Rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-2 text-start text-sm
Alert-action: absolute end-2 top-2, pe-18 on parent when present
usageHints: Use default for informational notices (sync complete, update available)
Use destructive for errors and warnings (auth expired, sync failed, run failed)
Include an icon for visual scanning (Lucide icons recommended)
Use alert-action for inline dismiss or retry buttons
Place alerts close to the relevant content, not just as global toasts
doNotInvent: Do not use success or warning variants (only default and destructive exist)
Do not add background colors beyond card background
Do not use rounded-xl (alert uses rounded-lg)
unknowns: Success variant not defined (use default with success icon)
Warning variant not defined (use default or destructive depending on severity)
